summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 8 covering: attribute editor persistence, Master Products pencil edit + Save/Save&Sync, Listings row-level edit, bulk Create Segment, Segments list + detail, Segment bulk sync, Request History table & filters, Alerts page (aggregated + filters), Listings & Channels Low Stock/OOS KPIs (visibility + click-to-filter + toggle), sidebar nav (Segments/Request History/Alerts), and cross-navigation for console errors. Executed via in-page navigation to preserve React Context state. All 25 assertions passed on the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: EditProductModal.saveAndSync uses setTimeout(80ms) to let updateProduct commit before pushProductToChannels. This works but is fragile — prefer flushing via a single reducer/action or reading fresh product state inside pushProductToChannels rather than relying on a race window.

EditListingModal 'Save & Push' actually only calls updateListing (state) — no separate push/sync step is performed; the button label implies a channel push. Either rename to 'Save' or wire an explicit push action for parity with EditProductModal.
Alerts KPI cards use very light backgrounds (#FDECEA/#FFF7E6) with default text; contrast is acceptable for headings but the small 'Detected:' meta text on white could be a touch brighter — minor.
Segments detail bulk sync fires a toast per product which can flood on large segments — consider a single aggregated toast + one request_history entry with a count.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral segment 'Test Segment T8' with 3 selected products; segment id auto-generated (e.g., seg_129209). Also mutated mp_001 title to 'Premium Cotton Tee EDITED', MRP=1299, stock=250 for persistence checks. Since state lives in React Context, this data is cleared on any hard page reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State is React Context — page.goto() resets it. Use sidebar links (data-testid='nav-*') to navigate between pages so in-memory mutations survive. Key test IDs: edit-<product_id>, edit-listing-<id>, edit-flat-<id>, ep-*, el-*, cs-*, seg-card-<id>, sd-row-<pid>, sd-select-<pid>, rh-row-<id>, al-item-<id>, kpi-low-stock, kpi-out-of-stock, lf-stock, bulk-create-segment, nav-{segments,requests,alerts}. Preseeded segments: seg_hero (mp_001+mp_004), seg_footwear (mp_001,mp_002,mp_003,mp_008). Request History seeded with 4 entries (grew to 11 during this run via edits/bulk-sync).
